task_description: Implement collapsible accordion-style behavior for tasks in the 'done' column of the kanban board. Tasks should be collapsed by default showing only essential info (title, badges), and smoothly expand when clicked to show full details. Use the existing Radix UI Collapsible component with CSS transitions for smooth animations.

patterns.radix_ui_collapsible: Use Collapsible from './ui/collapsible' - already has Radix UI wrappers
patterns.tailwind_transitions: Use 'transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out' for smooth animations
patterns.dnd_kit_integration: Preserve existing useSortable hook from @dnd-kit/sortable in SortableTaskCard
patterns.conditional_rendering: Check task.status === 'done' to apply accordion behavior only to done column

existing_implementations.kanban_board: apps/frontend/src/renderer/components/KanbanBoard.tsx - Uses DroppableColumn for each status, renders SortableTaskCard for each task
existing_implementations.task_card: apps/frontend/src/renderer/components/TaskCard.tsx - Full task card with title, badges, description, metadata, progress, actions
existing_implementations.collapsible_pattern: apps/frontend/src/renderer/components/project-settings/CollapsibleSection.tsx - Example of collapsible section with toggle state
